title: Magitech HUD Fix
body:
Magitech HUD Hider is a lightweight quality-of-life tweak designed to keep your screen clear of unnecessary UI elements.

By default, the Magitech mana bar remains on your screen at all times, which can feel intrusive—especially if you aren't currently focusing on magic or don't use the mod frequently. This mod introduces contextual visibility: the mana HUD remains hidden until you hold a spell or magical item in your hand.
Key Benefits:

- Immersive Gameplay: Eliminates screen clutter during exploration and building.
- Zero Configuration: Works out of the box—install it and forget it.
- Optimized for Multi-Modpacks: Perfect for players who have Magitech installed as part of a large pack but only use it occasionally.
